title: Decision record frontmatter, schema v1
$comment: Validated by scripts/check-decisions.mjs, and only for records carrying `schema: 1`. Records without that key are grandfathered and skipped — jig has no such records and should never acquire one, since it started with an empty corpus by DEC-J001's sibling reasoning. The `topic` enum is injected at validate time from docs/decisions/_config.json — it is deliberately absent here, because a topic list baked into a shared schema is a project-specific fact in a file that is not. jig's one divergence from muster's copy: `revisit_if` is required. 78% of muster's reservations corpus was dead because nothing retired anything, and a field that is optional is a field the corpus rots without.

schema.$comment: The gate. Its presence is what opts a record into validation at all.

topic.$comment: enum injected at validate time from docs/decisions/_config.json

ruling.$comment: The only field the operator reads. One sentence, plain English, no jargon.

revisit_if.$comment: Required in jig, optional in muster. The condition that makes this record worth re-opening, written so a person can tell whether it has fired. Expiry is the gap schema v1 does not close: nothing in the schema retires a record, so records accumulate until the corpus is 78% dead and nobody trusts any of it.

amends_spec.$comment: The DEC→SPEC leg, unchanged by schema v1. Absent from the v1 sketch, but gen:decisions writes the spec pointer from it and check() verifies the pointer landed — forbidding it here would break that for every rewritten record that amends the spec.
